g.title:
Logical Component: Mobile Application
Responsibilities: - UI/UX for product browsing - User authentication - Shopping cart management - Order placement - Loyalty program display

Logical Component: Backend Service
Responsibilities: - API orchestration - Business logic execution - Integration with external systems - Data transformation & mapping - Authentication & authorization

Logical Component: 3rd Party SDKs
Examples: - Analytics (Google Analytics, Mixpanel) - Push notifications (Firebase) - Crash reporting - A/B testing

External System: Legacy eCommerce Platform
Integration Protocol: - Product READ: XML/SOAP - Order WRITE: SOAP - Account SYNC: SOAP + Basic Auth - Cart SYNC: SOAP

External System: New SaaS eCommerce Platform
Integration Protocol: - Product READ: REST JSON - Order WRITE: REST JSON - Account SYNC: REST JSON + OAuth 2.0 - Cart SYNC: REST JSON
Migration Changes: - Fields renamed: itemId → sku, description → name - Auth: Basic → OAuth 2.0 - New fields: loyaltyId, preferences

External System: Legacy Loyalty Provider
Response Attributes: - customerId - points - tier - lastUpdated

External System: New Loyalty Provider
Response Attributes (Enhanced):
Legacy attributes: - customerId - points - tier - lastUpdated
NEW attributes: + rewardBalance (separate from points) + tierExpiryDate + availableRewards[] array + pointsHistory[] array + preferredRedemption + externalLoyaltyId

External System: New CRM Platform
Integration: - Trigger: Account creation event - Protocol: REST JSON + OAuth 2.0
Payload: - emailAddress (required) - contactPreferences { marketing, sms, email, push }
Purpose: - Customer master data - Marketing automation - GDPR compliance
